info.name: File Spoilers
info.summary: Hide file previews for files with configurable labels
info.description:
This app hides file previews (thumbnails) for files that have been labeled with configurable "spoiler" labels. Instead of showing the actual preview, a placeholder is displayed.
**Features:** - Hide previews for files matching configurable label conditions - Default: Files with label `sensitive=true` show placeholder - Multiple label triggers supported (OR logic) - Optional custom placeholder image - Right-click context menu to temporarily reveal preview
**Requirements:** - Requires `files_labels` app to be installed and enabled
**Use Cases:** - Hide sensitive photos from being visible while scrolling - Prevent shoulder-surfing in public places - Spoiler warnings for media content
**How It Works:** 1. Install and enable both `files_labels` and `files_spoilers` 2. Go to Settings → Personal → Files → Spoilers 3. Configure which labels trigger the spoiler (default: sensitive=true) 4. Label files using the Labels sidebar tab in Files app 5. Labeled files will show a placeholder instead of preview 6. Right-click a spoilered file and select "Reveal preview" to temporarily show it
